commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+3' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' What a chance that is! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
89' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' Substitution. Pablo Torre (Barcelona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pedri walks off.
86' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Gerard Martin provided an assist for the goal.
81' Here is a change. Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Balde.
81' Here comes a substitution. Pau Cubarsi is brought on as a substitute for Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
80' Here comes a substitution. Arnau Martinez (Girona) is given a rest as he is replaced by Gabriel Misehouy.
77' 3 - 1 Goal! Frenkie de Jong tees up Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 3:1.
76' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
75' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
74' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
73' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Barcelona, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
71' The substitution is prepared. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arthur Melo.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cristhian Stuani comes onto the pitch so that Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) can be given a rest.
70' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
70' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Juan Pulido had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
67' Here's the change. Fermin Lopez leaves the pitch and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
66' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) replacing Gavi.

66' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.

65' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
65' There's an opportunity for Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
65' Portu (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
61' 2 - 1 GOAL! Fermin Lopez meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
61' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Eric Garcia (Barcelona). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
59' Michel prepares a substitution. Yaser Asprilla is replaced by Portu (Girona).
57' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is teed up on the edge of the box by Daley Blind, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 1:1.
50' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
49' Pedri (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

48' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' The attendance for today's match is 48258.
47' Good team movement sets up Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
47' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Juan Pulido has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The game is interrupted as Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is flagged offside.
45+3' Pedri (Barcelona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' 1 - 0 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and the ball hits Ladislav Krejci (Girona), who finds the back of his own net. 1:0.
43' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will come up with.
42' What was Yangel Herrera (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
42' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
41' Poor challenge! Yangel Herrera (Girona) is penalised for tripping and Juan Pulido blows his whistle.
39' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jules Kounde (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
35' Pedri (Barcelona) sends the corner into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts it and averts the threat.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
30' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Pulido who sees an offensive foul.
29' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
28' Neat link-up play between Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) and Gavi, but Paulo Gazzaniga reads the game well and the move breaks down.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
23' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
22' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
22' The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
20' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and it's Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

15' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a brilliant save.
13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
12' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Barcelona, play can continue.

10' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
8' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
6' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
4' Paulo Gazzaniga leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pedri (Barcelona).
4' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Now Barcelona have a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Girona will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Pulido.
